tool_signatures.name: vk_events_get
tool_signatures.description: Read the community events received since vk_events_listen, oldest first. Pass the returned cursor as after next time to get only new ones. With wait (up to ${WAIT_SECONDS} seconds) it holds until something arrives — call it in a loop to follow the community, e.g. to answer each new comment.

tool_signatures.name: vk_events_listen
tool_signatures.description: Start receiving what happens in your community as it happens: new comments with their text and ID (so you can answer them with vk_wall_create_comment), likes, new posts and reposts, people joining and leaving, messages. Turns on the community\

tool_signatures.name: vk_friends_get
tool_signatures.description: List a user\

tool_signatures.name: vk_groups_get
tool_signatures.description: List the communities the token owner belongs to. Needs a user token — a community or service token cannot answer this.

tool_signatures.name: vk_groups_get_by_id
tool_signatures.description: Look up communities by numeric ID or short name (e.g. apiclub). Use it to resolve a name to an ID, or to read the description, member count and type before deciding what to do with it.

tool_signatures.name: vk_groups_get_members
tool_signatures.description: List the members of a community. Returns bare user IDs unless you ask for fields, in which case it returns profiles. Many communities hide their member list, which comes back as an access error rather than an empty list.

tool_signatures.name: vk_groups_join
tool_signatures.description: Join a community as the token owner, or send a join request if it is closed. group_id is positive here, without the minus sign.

tool_signatures.name: vk_groups_search
tool_signatures.description: Find communities by keyword, optionally narrowed by type, country, city or sort order. Returns matches with a total count.

tool_signatures.name: vk_likes_get
tool_signatures.description: List the users who liked or reacted to an object — a post, comment, photo or video — with counts per reaction. owner_id is negative for a community; item_id is the post or object ID.

tool_signatures.name: vk_messages_get_conversations
tool_signatures.description: List the conversations in your community\

tool_signatures.name: vk_messages_get_history
tool_signatures.description: Read the messages of one conversation in your community\

tool_signatures.name: vk_messages_mark_as_read
tool_signatures.description: Mark every message in one conversation of your community\

tool_signatures.name: vk_messages_send
tool_signatures.description: Send a message from your community to a person. VK only delivers to people who have written to the community or allowed it to message them. This reaches a real person: show the user the text before sending. Returns the new message_id.

tool_signatures.name: vk_newsfeed_get
tool_signatures.description: Read the token owner\

tool_signatures.name: vk_photos_get
tool_signatures.description: List photos from an album. album_id accepts wall, profile or saved as well as a numeric album ID. owner_id is negative for a community.

tool_signatures.name: vk_photos_upload_wall
tool_signatures.description: Upload a photo so it can be attached to a post. Takes a URL or a local file path, runs VK\

tool_signatures.name: vk_stats_get
tool_signatures.description: Read a community\

tool_signatures.name: vk_stories_post_photo
tool_signatures.description: Publish a photo story on VK (three-step upload: get upload server, upload the photo, save). Posts a personal story, or a community one when group_id is set.

tool_signatures.name: vk_stories_post_video
tool_signatures.description: Publish a video story on VK (three-step upload: get upload server, upload the video, save). Posts a personal story, or a community one when group_id is set.

tool_signatures.name: vk_token_info
tool_signatures.description: Say which VK token the server holds — a community token, a user token, a VK ID sign-in token or an app service key — which community it acts as and with which rights, which tools work with it, and for each tool that does not, what would make it work. Call it when unsure what you can do in VK, or before telling the user something cannot be done.

tool_signatures.name: vk_users_get
tool_signatures.description: Look up VK users by numeric ID or short name (e.g. durov). Use this to resolve a name to an ID before calling other tools, or to check whether a profile is closed.

tool_signatures.name: vk_users_search
tool_signatures.description: Find VK users by name, optionally narrowed by city, country, sex or age. Returns matches with a total count; page through them with offset.

tool_signatures.name: vk_wall_create_comment
tool_signatures.description: Add a comment to a post. owner_id is negative for a community. Returns the new comment_id.

tool_signatures.name: vk_wall_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete a post from a wall. owner_id is negative for a community. This cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: vk_wall_edit
tool_signatures.description: Replace the text or attachments of an existing post. owner_id is negative for a community. Editing overwrites the previous content, so pass the full new text rather than an addition.

tool_signatures.name: vk_wall_get
tool_signatures.description: Read posts from a user or community wall, newest first. Pass domain for a short address (durov) or owner_id for a numeric one — negative for a community, positive for a person. Each post carries its likes, reposts, comments and views.

tool_signatures.name: vk_wall_get_by_id
tool_signatures.description: Fetch particular posts by their full IDs in {owner_id}_{post_id} form, e.g. -1_340393. Use it to re-read a post you already know about, such as one you just published.

tool_signatures.name: vk_wall_post
tool_signatures.description: Publish a post on a wall. Under a community token, leave owner_id out and the post goes on that community\

tool_signatures.name: vkid
tool_signatures.description: Execute vkid
